PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday APRIL 13, 2017
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Eneix
Commissioner French and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of March 9, 2017
7A
8. Public Hearings
8A. Conditional Use Permits (CUP) 16-014 and 16-015
Siam Grocery/Shandra Thai Restaurant, Applicants
Conditional Use Permit 16-014 is a request to expand an existing grocery store with alcohol and tobacco sales (Siam Grocery) located at 2505 East Palmdale Boulevard, Suites C, D, and E; and, Conditional Use Permit 16-015 is a request to expand an existing bona fide restaurant (Shandra Thai Restaurant) 2505 East Palmdale Boulevard, Suites A and B.
Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-018 approving Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 16-014, to expand an existing grocery store with alcohol and tobacco sales (Siam Grocery); and, Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 16-015, to expand an existing bona fide restaurant (Shandra Thai Restaurant) with on-site alcohol sales and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review and that public convenience or necessity will be served by the grocery store use.
8A
8B. Conditional Use Permits (CUP) 17-002
Crab 'N Spice, LLC, Applicant
A request to establish a Type 41 Alcoholic Beverage Control license (On-sale Beer and Wine) within a bona fide restaurant (Crab 'N Spice) located at 40008 10th Street West, Suite 101.
Megan Taggart, Senior Planner Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-014 approving alcoholic beverage sales (Type 41, On-sale Beer and Wine) within a bona fide restaurant (Crab 'N Spice), and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review.
8B
8C. Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 61488 Time Extension (TE) No. 2
Royal Investors Group, LLC, Applicant
A request for a three-year time extension to TTM 61488 for the subdivision of approximately five acres into 16 single-family residential lots and one detention basin lot located at the northwest corner of Avenue R-6 and 30th Street East.
Megan Taggart, Senior Planner Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-013 approving Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 61488 Time Extension (TE) No. 2 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the Mitigated Negative Declaration adopted for TTM 61488 on March 17, 2005.
8C
8D. Tentative Parcel Map (TPM) 71222 Time Extension (TE) No. 1
ANJ Properties, LLC, Applicant
A request for a three-year time extension to combine two parcels totaling approximately two acres into a single parcel located at the southwest corner of Avenue N and 10th Street West.
Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-015 approving Tentative Parcel Map 71222 Time Extension No. 1, and find that the project will not result in any changes to the Negative Declaration adopted for TPM 71222 on January 14, 2010.
8D
8E. Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 61894 Time Extension (TE)
Alliance Land Planning & Engineering
A request for a three-year time extension for the subdivision of approximately 461 acres into 334 single-family residential lots, three detention basin lots and 29 open space lots located south of Avenue S and west of Parkwood Drive within the Anaverde Development.
Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission continue this item to the regular Planning Commission meeting of June 8, 2017, to allow the applicant to negotiate the revision of the Conditions of Approval due to the expiration of the Development Agreement.
8E
8F. Conditional Use Permits (CUP) 15-011
Los Cebollines Restaurant and Grill, Applicant
A request is to establish a bona fide restaurant (Los Cebollines Restaurant and Grill) within an approximately 3,000 square foot building located at 38575 6th Street East.
Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-017 denying Conditional Use Permit 15-011 for alcoholic beverage sales, based on the findings contained within the draft Resolution.
8F
9. Staff Communications Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
